propositions: Jira-specific probe code (REST URL construction, basic-auth GET, status classification) currently lives in backend-neutral core inbound_probe.py and must be relocated to adapters/jira/probe.py
A new SupportsAbsenceProbe capability protocol must be introduced to allow multiple backends to provide vendor-specific probe implementations without hard-coded imports
run_differs.py probe dispatch at line 369 must be routed through the backend capability instead of calling probe_mod.probe() directly
Neutral probe vocabulary (ProbeBranch, ProbeResult, ProbeConfigError) must remain at package root in inbound_probe.py to satisfy ADR 0035 location pinning
A backend lacking SupportsAbsenceProbe capability must degrade gracefully by returning ProbeResult(UNREACHABLE)
AST neutrality gate must enforce zero adapters.jira imports in inbound_probe.py
